review_candidates.title: CMS Migration SME- Technical PMO
review_candidates.description: Job Title: CMS Migration SME- Technical PM Term: 12 months Location: Cairo, Egypt Relevant experience: 10-15 years in cards technology/ issuer processing Mandatory requirements: Plus Platform, with exposure to other CMS platforms. Proven experience leading large-scale CMS or card portfolio migrations. Excellent understanding of portfolio optimization and customer conversion processes Hands-on experience with Mastercard (Issuing, Authorization, Clearing/Settlement, CMS) and cards technology, ideally in scheme migrations Purpose of Job: We are seeking a highly experienced CMS Migration SME to lead the end-to-end replacement of the client's current platform. The candidate will support on planning, data migration, testing, cutover and post-go-live stabilization— ensuring a smooth, controlled transition with minimal operational disruption. TASKS Core Responsibilities And Accountabilities Support the end-to-end migration from Vision Plus to the new CMS, covering discovery, planning, data migration, testing, cutover, and stabilization. Design and execute migration strategy, including data mapping, validation, mock runs, and reconciliation. Manage integrations, dependencies, risks, and readiness across business, IT, and vendor teams. Drive testing phases (SIT, UAT, end-to-end) and operational readiness. Coordinate cutover activities, go-/no-go decisions, and post-go-live hyper care. Provide clear stakeholder communication, status reporting, and issue resolution. Develop, maintain, and secure stakeholder alignment on the end-to-end Migration Masterplan, ensuring all workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths are effectively managed. Serve as the primary liaison between Mastercard and the Client, providing clear governance, coordination, and executive-level communication throughout the program lifecycle. Manage and oversee migration readiness activities including BIN setup, ICA assignment, membership requirements, CMS integration, processor connectivity, and Mastercard scheme certification. Lead card production and digital issuance activities, from card design and personalization through production, fulfilment, digital provisioning, and processor integration, ensuring compliance with Mastercard standards. Drive the implementation and launch of digital payment capabilities including Apple Pay, Google Pay, xPay, tokenization services, MDES enablement, 3DS authentication, and end-to-end digital wallet validation. Oversee testing, certification, and quality assurance activities including MIP testing, parameterization, configuration management, SIT, UAT, performance testing, security testing, and operational readiness. Ensure successful configuration and readiness of authorization, authentication, dispute management, and post?launch support processes, including stabilization and transition to BAU teams. Coordinate cross-functional teams across Technology, Product, Operations, Marketing, Procurement, and external partners to deliver program objectives in line with agreed timelines. Knowledge and Skills** 10–15 years of experience in cards technology and issuer processing. 10 years+ of experience in project management, with a focus on end-to end project management of complex projects within the banking / payment's domain Strong, hands-on expertise with Vision Plus, with exposure to other CMS platforms. Proven experience leading large-scale CMS or card portfolio migrations. Deep knowledge of card lifecycle, data migration, reconciliation, and integrations. Experience with testing, cutover execution, and production stabilization. Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field; MBA on top preferred. 10 years+ of experience in project management, with a focus on end-to end project management of complex projects within the banking / payment's domain Deep understanding of card management systems (e.g., Way4, Cortex, Prime), issuer processing, and card lifecycle (issuance authorisation clearing settlement disputes) ISO 8583 / ISO 20022 messaging standards, BIN management, personalisation, tokenisation (MDES/VTS), 3DS, and digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay

review_candidates.title: Programing & Robotics STEM instructor for kids
review_candidates.description: Company Description فيـوتشر تكنولوجي is an education-focused organization dedicated to introducing children to programming, robotics, and core STEM concepts through engaging, hands-on learning. The company designs age-appropriate curricula that help learners build problem-solving, creativity, and critical thinking skills. Programs are delivered in a supportive environment that encourages curiosity, collaboration, and experimentation with technology. فيـوتشر تكنولوجي aims to prepare young learners for future careers in science and technology by making complex topics accessible and fun. Role Description The Programming & Robotics STEM Instructor for kids is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. The instructor will plan and deliver interactive lessons in programming, robotics, and STEM concepts for children of various age groups, using practical projects, games, and activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing lesson materials, setting up and managing robotics kits and devices, guiding students through coding exercises, and ensuring a safe, inclusive classroom environment. The instructor will monitor student progress, provide constructive feedback, communicate regularly with parents or guardians about learning outcomes, and participate in team meetings to refine curriculum and teaching methods. The role also involves supporting workshops, events, and demonstrations that showcase students’ projects and promote the program. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Programming and Robotics, with experience using educational coding platforms or robotics kits for children. Candidates should possess a solid foundation in STEM disciplines and Training skills, including designing and delivering structured lessons or workshops for young learners. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, age-appropriate language and engage learners with diverse backgrounds. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Education, or a related field is preferred. Prior experience teaching or mentoring children in technology or STEM programs is highly beneficial. Ability to manage a classroom, maintain safety standards, and adapt teaching strategies to different learning styles. Strong organizational skills, reliability, and a genuine interest in youth development and educational technology. Comfort working on-site in Qesm El Maadi and collaborating within a multidisciplinary educational team.
